classification_rule: A visible scientific fragment must own an independent scientific question or inferential contract. Repository existence alone is not enough. Programme membership does not imply a linear dependency.

azami.spine: present phenotype -> public evolutionary history -> own-data discrimination

flower.spine: space <-> evolutionary time; hotarubukuro is focal/origin anchor, not Chapter-3 dependence

island.spine: WHEN/WHERE -> conditional response WHY -> focal phenotype axes

observation.spine: PolliPi -> InsePi physical mainline; InsePi ... TNOA abstraction; REC -> TNOA information flow while TNOA -> REC is development lineage

crest_state_theory.spine: CCOC/MLTR/MRM -> CREST -> CED; theouni is meta-layer

aza3.owner: own-data discrimination after EAzami public-data Chapter 2
aza3.public_line: 残った歴史は、同じ個体に結びついた証拠で分ける。
aza3.claim_ceiling: No definitive Japan-wide species tree, causal history, functional mechanism or fitness conclusion before same-individual ancestry/phenotype/cytotype data and separately authorized functional evidence exist.

284b.promotion_gate: Declare an independent question, inherited v2.8.4 boundary, evidence contract, claim ceiling and terminal outcomes; otherwise remain staging or return work to SDMR.

zuizui0223.github.io.role: portfolio registry, provenance-preserving visualization and navigation
